body:
From the review in https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaUtilities.jl/pull/258, it mentioned that the time dimension is accessed from a dataset instead of the variable of interest. This PR makes the same kind of change in https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaUtilities.jl/pull/258 to get the right time dimension if there are two or more time dimensions in the dataset.
